pr_title: Adding Status Logging to AWS Kinesis/Firehose Logger Plugins
pr_body:
The Kinesis/Firehose logger plugin can now send status logs.

Closes #3077

The tests for AWS Firehose/Kinesis used non-JSON content to test the `send` function of the respective logger plugins. This actually causes problems since we assume (similar to the TLS logger plugin) that the `std::vector` of `std::string`s as passed into `send` contain strings of serialized JSON content. I fixed this by making the tests JSON strings as per the assumption.

issue_context.title: AWS-based plugins do not implement status logging
issue_context.body:
I cannot remember if the AWS logger plugins:
https://github.com/facebook/osquery/blob/master/osquery/logger/plugins/aws_firehose.h#L29
https://github.com/facebook/osquery/blob/master/osquery/logger/plugins/aws_kinesis.h#L29

did not implement `logStatus` for a reason? Perhaps @zwass remembers?
comments:
My memory is that @mime-frame and @jacknagz didn't want to have status logs going to those plugins at the time they were implemented. Unfortunately we don't have the Slack archives, so I can't go back to the actual conversations to understand this better.

I know that they want those status logs in the plugins now, and I don't see any reason not to implement that (but it's not something I can take on right now).

review_comments: Maybe this is the only way to assure `log_type` is added correctly.

@theopolis It may be possible to add another argument (maybe a `bool` indicating whether to label the log item?) to `logString` and `logStatus` in `BufferedLogForwarder`. On `true`, this would append an extra `log_type` key with `"status"` in `logStatus`. For `logString`, it would deserialize the string as JSON and append the `log_type` key with `"results"` prior to reserialization.
